title: BONNYLOU x THOMAS ATLAS – MATINEE SHOW
description:
Saturday Matinee Double Header: Bonnylou & Thomas Atlas (Acoustic)

Performance Times:

Doors open at 2pm

Show starts at 2.45pm

Show ends at 5.30pm

Spend your Saturday afternoon soaking up two phenomenal Birmingham talents for an unforgettable matinee performance.

Bonnylou
Bonnylou has been a firmly established mainstay of the Birmingham music scene for well over a decade. Performing a polished and energetic set of Rhythm & Blues, Soul Standards & well crafted original material at venues up and down the country. With an accomplished line-up of Birmingham’s finest, Bonnylou live is a show not to be missed!

Thomas Atlas 

Singer-songwriter and guitarist Thomas Atlas is redefining modern music with a bold fusion of blues, soul, funk, jazz, and Americana. From viral “Garage Funk” videos to sold-out shows at legendary venues like Ronnie Scott’s to  Birmingham Symphony Hall, Thomas has captivated audiences with his dynamic sound and magnetic stage presence.

His debut album, featuring the hit track “Juice” (now streaming over 400k times), launched him onto the international scene, earning acclaim for his electrifying guitar work and soulful performances.

Now, with collaborations alongside Robin Monotti (Eric Clapton) and studio legend Richard Digby Smith (Led Zeppelin, Bob Marley), Thomas is crafting his highly anticipated second album. As his creative journey evolves, Thomas Atlas continues to push boundaries—bringing raw energy, heartfelt songwriting, and genre-defying music to fans around the world.

“I’ve been listening to Thomas Atlas on Youtube and he’s pretty nifty” Eric Clapton

title: Etana
description:
Etana is a two-time Grammy-nominated Goddess of Reggae. From her breakout anthem “Wrong Address” to her Grammy-nominated albums Reggae Forever (2018) and Pamoja (2021), Etana has consistently made history as a trailblazer and a force in reggae music.

Born Shauna McKenzie, Etana continued to achieve remarkable milestones. Her album “I Rise” made history by claiming the coveted #1 spot on the Reggae Billboard chart, breaking a seventeen-year drought for female artists from Jamaica.

Her unique sound effortlessly weaves together elements of soul, reggae, dancehall, & R&B.  In a world where talent is abundant, Etana shines as a beacon of authenticity and artistry.

title: An Evening of… Marvin Gaye, Al Green & David Ruffin
description:
Miles Christian sings the Music of Marvin Gaye, Al Green & David Ruffin… Get ready for an unforgettable evening celebrating three of the greatest voices in soul music!

Join Miles Christian as he pays tribute to the timeless music of Marvin Gaye, Al Green & David Ruffin, performing the songs that defined a generation with the passion, style and authenticity they deserve.

Blessed with an exceptional voice and an incredible stage presence, Miles has built a reputation as one of the UK’s finest soul performers. Coming from true musical heritage as the son of Garry Christian of legendary British soul band The Christians, soul music runs through his veins.

Before launching his acclaimed solo tribute shows, Miles made his name portraying Bobby Byrd in The James Brown Experience and as the lead male vocalist in Northern Soul Music, earning praise for his powerful vocals and captivating live performances.

Expect an evening packed with iconic hits including ‘Let’s Get It On’, ‘Sexual Healing’, ‘What’s Going On’,  ‘Let’s Stay Together’, ‘Love and Happiness’, ‘Tired of Being Alone’, ‘My Girl’, ‘Ain’t Too Proud to Beg’,  ‘I Wish It Would Rain’ and many more soul classics.

One voice. Three legends. An unforgettable night of classic soul!

title: MICA PARIS
description:
Following last year’s sell-out show, Mica Paris returns to the Jam House with her hits including ’My One Temptation’,  ‘Breathe Life Into Me’ and ‘Where Is The Love?’.

Mica made an immediate impact on the UK music scene in 1988 when she released her debut, the platinum-selling ‘So Good’ album. She followed with more worldwide hit albums and singles including ‘Black Angel’, ‘Stay’ and ‘Carefree’, and has collaborated with many respected artists such as Prince and Jools Holland leading to her to being considered one of the UK’s most respected female singers with the terrific range, power, and sheer soulfulness of her voice.

Her most recent album “Gospel” was released to critical acclaim and #1 in the UK R&B Album charts. The album features an original song “The Struggle”, telling the story of Mica’s meeting with Gladys Knight, as well as spellbinding versions of Rag ‘N’ Bone Man’s “Human”; John Newton’s hymn “Amazing Grace”; Foreigner’s “I Want To Know What Love Is”; and U2’s “I Still Haven’t Found What I’m Looking For”.

Mica was awarded an MBE in the 2020 Birthday Honours for services to music, entertainment and charity.

title: Rebecca Ferguson
description:
Over fifteen years since discovery and Rebecca Ferguson MBE remains a well respected, multi genre artist admired for not only her unique sound but her songwriting capabilities. Ferguson is one of the biggest musical talents and most recognisable personalities to emerge from Liverpool in the past 30 years.

After becoming The X Factor’s first female runner-up, Rebecca has proved popular with people of varying ages – she was not only the X Factor’s National Sweetheart but is widely regarded as one of the shows very best talents as 19.4 million people watched that year’s final, where she finished one place ahead of One Direction.

‘Heaven’ released in 2011, sold over 130,000 copies in its first week, making it the fastest selling debut album by a solo artist that decade, between 2007- 2017. With singles such as ‘Glitter & Gold’, ‘I Hope’ and ‘Nothing’s Real But Love’, she has been lauded by critics, with The Telegraph declaring her ‘The same league as Aretha Franklin’, and the Guardian stating that ‘Her talent is undeniable’; whilst Ferguson has also been nominated for MOBO and MTV Europe Music Awards.

Her last album, Heaven Part II, was released at the end of 2023 and by early 2024 had already been a BBC Radio 2 Album of the Week.

title: The Vintage Explosion
description:
The Vintage Explosion lit up the global stage in November 2022 when their soul-drenched cover of Sam Cooke’s ‘A Change is Gonna Come’ went viral racking up over 1 billion views and impressions across Tik-Tok, Facebook, and beyond. Since then, this electrifying Scottish outfit has carved a meteoric path through the musical world.

Since then they have had four No.1 albums on the Worldwide iTunes Blues Album Chart, No.3 on the Worldwide iTunes Album Chart – just behind Taylor Swift and ahead of Arctic Monkeys – as well as top ten on the US Billboard Blues Album Chart. They sold out a 14 date UK Tour, were specially invited to perform at the BBC Big Birthday Bash on TV as the house band and made their live debut on national TV in the UK on This Morning on ITV. 
 
Their debut studio album of 10 self-penned modern classics, ‘Havin’ Such A Good Time’, featuring No.1 singles ‘Don’t Knock Upon My Door’ & ‘Take My Troubles Away’ went straight to No.1 on the Worldwide iTunes Blues Album Chart upon release in Aug 2023, outselling the likes of Joe Bonamassa and Van Morrison. 
 
‘A stunning debut album, pin-balling across multiple genres’ – Vintage Rock Magazine

title: OMAR
description:
Omar Lyefook MBE is without doubt, one of the greatest soul music talents the United Kingdom has produced in the last 40 years. If anyone has doubts about that, then they might want to consider the list of legendary artists who happily line up to collaborate with him musically, or simply sing his praises – from Stevie Wonder, the late Leon Ware, Erykah Badu, Common, through to Carleen Anderson, D’Angelo, and Soul II Soul’s Caron Wheeler, Angie Stone and U.K. artists Courtney Pine, Rodney P, Kele LeRoc, Natasha Watts and Estelle, all appreciate his truly original and unique voice, musicianship and songwriting talent.

First gaining international attention via that signature hit, “There’s Nothing Like This”, Omar launched his series of standout solo albums, the latest of which Brighter The Days was released to great acclaim in late 2025, with a remixed album being released in June 2026.

“When I grow up I wanna be Omar” Stevie Wonder

“One of the best voices I’ve ever heard” Erykah Badu

“Do drop off a copy of your new album when it’s finished” King Charles

“His importance as an artist within soul music cannot be understated” BBC
